responsibility: When ProgressActor holds pending progress, present Continue/Restart only through a production task-reconstruction boundary. Reading TaskProgress alone is not completion evidence; without a registered launcher the surface must fail visibly instead of reporting resumed or restarted.

inputs.taskType: TaskType of the task about to start
inputs.pendingProgress: TaskProgress? loaded from ProgressActor (taskId, lastProcessedIndex, totalCount)
inputs.resumePoint: lastProcessedIndex / totalCount shown to the user
inputs.taskLauncher: Composition-owned registry that can reconstruct the persisted taskType and validates stale or unknown task identities

outputs.visibleContent: Confirmation dialog: '检测到未完成的进度（已完成 X / Y），是否继续？' with Continue / Restart buttons
outputs.interactionTargets: promptContinue through the registered launcher, promptRestart after transactional progress reset, errorRetry
outputs.accessibilityTree: Dialog title, progress text (X of Y), Continue button, Restart button

systemContainer: Alert / confirmationDialog presented from the task-start host (e.g. BackgroundTaskPanel or Home)
fallbackConditions: No pending progress for task type -> auto-start new task, no prompt (state: none)
ProgressActor load failure -> L2 error state with retry (state: error)
Missing, stale or unknown production task launcher -> honest unavailable/error state; never a fixture-backed success
